free_tier.stated: "Upload as much as you need! Unlimited volume of uploaded files" — no document count or account quota; dokument.pub FAQ caps a single PDF at 200 MB and states "No limitation" on number of pages/uploads. Per-record unlimited x unlimited records.

egress.terms: Free public HTTP: every document has a permanent public page and a download endpoint (idoc.pub: /download-file-partner/<slug>?hash=<md5-like>); no auth, no metering, no expiry documented.

tooling: No API. Upload is a browser form behind Cloudflare/nginx bot filtering; download is a plain GET. No rclone backend, no known maintained client.
chaining: Per-record unlimited means the chain is just 'keep uploading': 200 MB/PDF x unlimited PDFs. But every unit needs a form POST, so throughput is bounded by bot defences, not quota.
limits_note: 200 MB per PDF (dokument.pub); 150 MB-200 MB per file on siblings; three-step moderation/approval before publishing (idoc.pub); file types restricted to PDF/DOC/PPT.
reliability_note: Upload path is walled by an automated-traffic filter and by login (idoc.pub), so unattended bulk ingest fails.

evidence.proved: 'The max PDF file size is 200 MB'; 'Is there a limitation on the number of ... uploads? No limitation.'
'Upload as much as you need! Unlimited volume of uploaded files. You may publish any number of documents in PDF, Microsoft Word and PowerPoint format.'
